thread:
Sam: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands security segment. Can we capture owners + short dates for SOC2/ISO evidence, BYO KMS, VPC private connectivity, and audit-log retention so sales/support have one place?

Isha: Happy to coordinate. High level: initial SOC2 evidence bundle by mid-June; BYO KMS (customerontrolled keys) targeted beta in ~8 weeks; audit-log retention exposed up to 365 days behind a flag.

Jordan: Tech note: AWS PrivateLink + VPC endpoints is our primary recommendation for zero-egress private deployments. We still offer VPC peering for legacy customers but it requires manual routing/NAT config.

Maggie: For ISO mapping we need additional artifacts (access review exports, key policy snapshots, rotation records). Infra please export examples so compliance can template evidence.

Sam: Can we list DRIs and short due dates so folks can reference?

Isha: Draft DRIs/dates: SOC2 evidence -> Isha (security) + Kira (compliance) — due 2026-06-15. BYO KMS beta -> Jordan (infra) + Sam (product) — due 2026-05-20. PrivateLink/VPC checklist -> Jordan — due 2026-05-01. Audit-log retention flag -> Kira + Jordan — due 2026-05-10.

Jordan: Will publish terraform module PR and PrivateLink doc with an example endpoint policy snippet.

Kira: Audit logs: default stays 90 days; tenant-level control will allow up to 365 days and provide an export endpoint. Product needs UX for retention setting.

Security-Bot: Scan alert: 3 infra accounts missing explicit KMS key policy statements in the last 24h. Ticket INFRA-4823 created.

Maggie: Compliance nuance: SOC2 requires documented key rotation policy and HSM attestation if customers use external HSMs with BYO KMS. Isha, can security draft a customer-facing checklist and attestation template?

Isha: Yes — will draft checklist (key policy review, rotation cadence, KMS grants, HSM attestation) and share by 2026-04-28.

Sam: Also proposing weekly 30m office hours for compliance Qs until SOC2 milestone; Tuesdays 9am PT. Jordan to schedule recurring invite.

Jordan: OK, will schedule and invite legal/security.

Sam: Recap of actions:
- SOC2 evidence package -> Isha + Kira -> 2026-06-15
- BYO KMS beta -> Jordan + Sam -> 2026-05-20
- PrivateLink/VPC checklist -> Jordan -> 2026-05-01
- Audit-log retention flag -> Kira + Jordan -> 2026-05-10
- Customer KMS/HSM checklist -> Isha -> draft 2026-04-28
- Weekly office hours Tuesdays 9am PT -> Jordan to schedule

Sam: If anyone needs to swap ownership or change dates, reply here. I'll consolidate into Confluence and ping when live. :thumbsup:
